subject.why: The illustration clearly depicts two interlocked gold wedding rings with a small pink ribbon bow tied through them.

category.why: The rings float freely in the air at a dynamic angle with no surface underneath, set against a saturated gradient background with centered radiating rays.

clean.why: There are no text, UI elements, watermarks, borders, or characters.

framing.why: The subject is centrally positioned with comfortable, clear margins on all four sides.

colour.why: The warm gold and pink tones contrast sharply and attractively against the bright, saturated purple background.

detail.why: The geometry is clean and free of micro-textures, scratches, or unnecessary extra props.

style.why: Smooth, chunky 3D volumes with soft satin highlights, matching the reference style perfectly.
